description: When a download from Parts Velocity finishes, the message reads "Success — Data exported successfully." That is a general message that could belong to any screen. It does not name the report or say which file was produced.
steps: Set the date range to This Year with both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310 selected and Type set to Both, and type BRAKECLEAN into the report's search box so the view is small enough to download.
Open the three-dot menu, choose Download (CSV), and watch the message that appears.
Do it again and choose Download (PDF), and watch the message that appears.
current:
Both downloads show the same message: "Success" then "Data exported successfully."

A message does appear for both file types, so nothing is missing — the wording is wrong. The failure message is correct: when a download is refused, the server's own message is passed through word for word.
expected: A successful download says which report and which file type it produced: "Velocity report exported (CSV)" or "Velocity report exported (PDF)".
source: On a successful download, a success toast reads "Velocity report exported (CSV)" or "Velocity report exported (PDF)".
